title: Rodri Castle sees a giant triangle and black team during Hunter Warrior

tellings.quote: crash retrieval encounter. And then there's Rodri Castle who during the Hunter Warrior advanced war fighting experiment in 1997 while he was an AV8B Harrier aviation technician. Uh basically was ordered to check out some unauthorized flare activity. He saw a massive 2003 300t triangle and accompanying black team. He was held at gunpoint.
Roger Castle, 150 ft away from a giant rotating triangle whose characteristics are almost exactly similar to to TR3B
tellings.difference: Places it in Nevada, calls the triangle rotating at 150 ft and compares it to the TR-3B. It leaves out the 1997 date, the black team and the gunpoint detail.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the same witness, Castle (Roger here, Rodri in the story), seeing a giant triangle up close. This is most likely the Hunter Warrior encounter.

plain: A researcher known online as UAPGerb relays the account of Rodri Castle, who in 1997 was a technician on the Harrier, a military jump jet, during Hunter Warrior, a military exercise testing new ways of fighting. According to UAPGerb, Castle was sent to check on unauthorised flares, came upon a huge triangular craft guarded by a "black team", meaning an unmarked security crew, and was held at gunpoint. In another retelling UAPGerb calls him Roger Castle, places it in Nevada, and says he stood about 150 feet from a rotating triangle much like the TR-3B, a secret triangular aircraft rumoured to exist.
